study: cached-posterior decision audit of the frozen V2 comparison (decision-only readouts; zero new fits)
fits: none; the exported V2 component posteriors of v2_model_comparison (V2_EP_mixture, its rho=1 EP component as rho1_EP, Binary_V2_EP), NEW DEV repeats 1-2, folds 1-5, B16/B40

rules.finite_batch: A_m >= B_m (prospective IID batch, m = 136, fixed fold-pool reference)

target_distribution: uniform over the fixed fold training-candidate inputs (never the paid subset); a model-based approximation to the eligible feature distribution; may be biased for another deployment population
m_source: NEW population size from the feature/provenance intake (not its positive count)

numerics.QMC: scrambled Sobol, 4 scrambles, seeds 771 + 1009 s + 37 k, ladder 2^10 -> 2^12 -> 2^14
numerics.accept: max signed-margin change <= 0.015 and pi change <= 0.003
numerics.ambiguous: |signed margin| <= max(2 SE over scrambles, last margin change); the sign of the estimate is used and the flag reported (distinct from numerical failure)
numerics.failure: a checkpoint whose ladder is not accepted or whose QMC decision pass fails is DECISION_NUMERICAL_STOP; nonfinite coefficients, margins or ladder changes are DECISION_NONFINITE; their finite_batch and posterior_mean_pi decisions are kept as failed output and never scored; no seed, ladder or tolerance change and no retry

acceptance.order: export validity -> probability parity -> QMC decisions -> finiteness -> ladder acceptance
acceptance.p_parity_definition: max over test inputs of |closed-form mixture probability from the export - stored V2 prediction|; all values finite

statuses.INVALID_EXPORT: missing, altered or inconsistent export, failed fit, or missing/duplicated/misaligned simulation IDs: no rule
statuses.PROBABILITY_PARITY_FAILURE: export probabilities differ from the stored V2 predictions: no rule

acceptance.readout: a pooled-per-repeat readout is AVAILABLE only if all five folds are valid for that rule and the five test sets partition the NEW population; otherwise UNAVAILABLE (no surviving-subset metric)
acceptance.contrast: a rule - cutoff_0.5 contrast needs both readouts available in both repeats
acceptance.primary: finite_batch on all 20 V2_EP_mixture checkpoints (2 repeats x 5 folds x B16/B40); COMPLETE only if all 20 are ok, otherwise PRIMARY_UNAVAILABLE
acceptance.unavailable_primary: evaluate writes DECISION_AUDIT_UNAVAILABLE.json instead of DECISION_AUDIT_SUMMARY.json (the queue's T08 completion marker) and exits with code 3

protections: no held-out label, global label count, short-K or q20 membership, test depth or post-hoc VX cut enters a decision
probability parity enforced per checkpoint (max absolute difference <= 1e-10); the three cutoff rules use that single probability vector
no rule is tuned on these metrics
not an acquisition or simulation-saving experiment
metrics: class fractions: model reference prevalence E[pi|D], paid fraction, evaluator-only true fractions (never learner inputs)
uncertainty: Stage M class-stratified simulation-cluster bootstrap (2000, seed 20261013), conditional on the stored fits and splits
